sections.title: RetroMC plugins
sections.description: Mostly from the RetroMC Development Group, which maintains Poseidon-ready forks and originals. Check each repo's Releases page; some (like Fundamentals) are build-from-source with `mvn clean package`.
sections.note: **Compatibility:** plugins built for the original 2011 CraftBukkit often load on Poseidon, but not always, because Poseidon's API differs. Test every jar on a local server first, and only download jars from sources you trust.
